summary: Model card for Gemini 3.6 Flash. Reports price and capability benchmarks vs Gemini and competitor models, automated safety deltas vs Gemini 3.5 Flash with direction labels, Trust & Safety red teaming summary, frontier safety inherited from Gemini 3.1 Pro plus additional cyber testing, and enhanced CBRN/cyber jailbreak safeguards.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: No CCL reached (relies on Gemini 3.1 Pro; additional cyber testing below cyber CCL)
framework.quote: we are confident that Gemini 3.6 Flash is also unlikely to reach any CCLs.

evals: Frontier safety inherited from proxy model
cbrn_bio_chem.finding: No model-specific frontier evaluation; relies on Gemini 3.1 Pro results.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: we are confident that Gemini 3.6 Flash is also unlikely to reach any CCLs.

cyber.finding: Additional cyber testing because prior Gemini 3 models reached alert threshold; remains below cyber CCL; no numbers.
cyber.quote: we performed additional testing in this domain and found that Gemini 3.6 Flash remains below the cyber CCL.

evals: Frontier safety inherited from proxy model
autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: No model-specific frontier evaluation; relies on Gemini 3.1 Pro results.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: we are confident that Gemini 3.6 Flash is also unlikely to reach any CCLs.

metrics.name: Text to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.5 Flash
Image to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.5 Flash

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Automated content-safety results reported only as relative deltas vs Gemini 3.5 Flash; manual review said losses were false positives or not egregious. Tone regressed slightly (-3.31%), which authors say does not impact overall safety.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Overall, Gemini 3.6 Flash outperforms Gemini 3.5 Flash across both multi-lingual and content safety, while continuing to keep unjustified refusals low.

over_refusal.finding: Single relative delta on borderline prompts.
over_refusal.quote: Automated evaluation measuring model's ability to respond to borderline prompts while remaining safe

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Jailbreak resistance named as ongoing work; enhanced frontier safeguards for CBRN and cyber misuse to resist jailbreaks. No numbers.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: To make Gemini 3.6 Flash more resistant to jailbreaks, we enhanced Frontier Safety safeguards in the domains of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) and cyber offense misuses.

honesty_hallucination.quote: Gemini 3.6 Flash may exhibit some of the general limitations of foundation models, such as hallucinations.

evals: Human red teaming child safety launch thresholds
child_safety.finding: Satisfied child-safety launch thresholds; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: For child safety evaluations, Gemini 3.6 Flash satisfied required launch thresholds

multilingual_safety.quote: Automated safety policy evaluation across multiple languages

system_safeguards.finding: Enhanced FSF safeguards for CBRN and cyber; trained to minimize refusals for beneficial uses.
system_safeguards.quote: We also trained the model to minimize refusals for beneficial uses.

notable_new_eval_methods: Red teaming attributed to Google's Trust & Safety organization (p.7)

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety results computed with improved evaluations, not directly comparable with previous model cards.
